dataIdInfo.idAbs: This feature class is a modified subset of the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) National Risk Index census tract-level dataset. Indicators were adjusted for educational purposes.
dataIdInfo.idPurp: This feature class contains most census tracts of California. This data is intended to be used as the prediction dataset for a forest-based regression analysis.
